Signature.purpose: One node of the pipeline diagram: a stage
Signature.description: A stage shows its count, and its queue count on its top-right corner when it has one. Pressing it selects it. The caption is cut at one line; the panel shows it whole.

button.class: relative w-[10rem] min-h-22 min-w-0 text-left rounded-box border px-3 py-2 flex flex-col gap-0.5 cursor-pointer transition-colors duration-150 motion-safe:active:scale-[0.98] bg-base-200 {node.selected ? 'border-primary' : 'border-base-content/15 hover:border-base-content/35'}

span.title: {R.pipeline.inQueue}
span.class: badge badge-sm absolute -top-2.5 -right-2.5 gap-1 tabular-nums {node.queued GT 0 ? 'badge-primary' : 'badge-neutral'}
flex items-center gap-2 text-sm font-medium leading-tight min-w-0 {node.queue ? 'pr-8' : ''}
badge badge-xs badge-ghost ml-auto shrink-0 gap-1
